Formula for Planetary gear systems:
Sun Teeth = ringTeeth - 2 * planetTeeth
Planet Teeth = (ringTeeth - sunTeeth) / 2
Ring Teeth = sunTeeth + 2 * planetTeeth

ST = sunTeeth
PT = planetTeeth
RT = ringTeeth
SunSpeed = (ST+RT)/ST * PlanetCarrierSpeed - RT/ST * RingSpeed
PlanetCarrierSpeed = RT/(ST+RT) * RingSpeed + ST/(ST+RT) * SunSpeed
RingSpeed = (ST+RT)/RT * PlanetCarrierSpeed - ST/RT * SunSpeed
